props.author: Stoiiic
props.text:
My thought process is that BTC is in the final phase of the HTF downtrend.

Believe this is the last bit where most will take their eyes off the ball.

Just a matter of time based bottoming structure from here on out.

If there happens to be forced selling to break into a new low, good.

If it's just time based chop and the low doesn't get crushed, good.

There will continue to be opportunities in the future.

Pay attention the next few months.

A little more patience.
